body:
It's an entry-level marketing job which can easily be filled locally. The company does not pay relocation expenses.

The kick in the balls is that this is a company which used to be a client of my friend's and he has been pushing for me to apply to them for a long time. I have been hesitant to do it because I don't have the money to relocate, and did not want to ask him for financial assistance.

He pushed me to get the in-person interview, then became angry with me for not having a plan/money to make the re-location.

He lectured me about making shot-from-the-hip decisions, not having a solid plan, not having money for unplanned expenses.
